newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips recover gains, NYSE re-imposes curbs.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips recover gains, NYSE re-imposes curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks rebounded in late afternoon trade, as markets took a choppy turn and program activity began to dominate the session.
The Dow industrials rose 52 points to 6825, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to re-impose index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1524 EST/2024 GMT. The S&P 500 rose seven to 787.
Analysts said program trades linked to bond market activity appeared to be dictating the direction of stocks.

"Most decisions by money managers have already been made by this time on a Friday," said Anthony O'Bryan, market analyst at A.G. Edwards. "What you get now are a lot of programs in what is probably a thin market."
